tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250nyang gter khros nag gi tshogs mchod grangs mang gsog skabs byin rlabs ni/1$0000300 raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i ka pā lar dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga me rlung gis sbyangs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thim pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hūm̐:

tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo yum: thugs rjes khros pa'i nag mo la: mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: mchod pa ni/ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba dang: bshos dang zhal zas sna tshogs dang: kha dang mngar dang skyur ba dang: tsha dang rtsub dang lan tshwa'i ro: gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang reg: 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa yis: rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: oṃ shrī badzra bha ra he kro dhī kā lī ha ri ni sa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hūm̐: 'dod gsol ni/ hūm̐: tshogs mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub stsol: tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod dang: 'khor dang rkang 'gros nor phyugs spel: ma lus thams cad dbang du sdus: dus min 'chi dang chag che zlog: gnam phud ni/ hūm̐: dgongs shig rje btsun bla ma rnams: dgongs shig yi dam lha tshogs rnams: dgongs shig mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs: sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs te: phud gtor gtsang ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: bde ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs: oṃ a mṛta pra tītstsha sa ma ya khā hi: lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro ging lang dbang phyug ma// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// pho nya la sogs tshogs lhag sdud// ting 'dzin drod nyul nyams len ma: mchod sbyin bzang po 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ utstshiṣṭa sarba ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi: mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces brjod do// zhes mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i gsung rab las khol du phyungs pa dge// /
